faq.a: Points are used each time a tool delivers a result. Heavier tools, such as video, cost more points than lighter ones, such as scripts.

faq.q: Do I lose points if a generation fails?
faq.a: No. Points are only taken when a tool returns a valid result. Failed generations cost nothing.

faq.q: How many points do I start with?
faq.a: Every new account starts with 100 free points.

faq.q: Can I use my creations commercially?
faq.a: Commercial-use rules will be published with the final plans. Check back before you publish anything.

faq.q: How do I get more points?
faq.a: Open Pricing & Points to see plans and top-up packs. Online payments are opening soon.

faq.q: Which devices does Nexora Ai support?
faq.a: The app is planned for Android and iOS, with this web dashboard alongside it.
